text:
jen: Customer on prod seeing intermittent 401s and `Event loop is closed` during a graceful deploy. They use redwood-py 0.9.4 in a FastAPI app, background async work wrapped with the sync helper. Happening during a high-concurrency burst, and looks tied to token refresh + retries.
omar: Can you paste the minimal repro and logs?
jen: Logs from customer (sanitized):
```
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/httpx/_exceptions.py", line 528, in _handle_response
    raise HTTPStatusError(message, request=request, response=response)
httpx.HTTPStatusError: 401 Client Error: Unauthorized for url: https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
During handling of the above exception, another exception occurred:
  File "/app/worker.py", line 72, in _background_loop
    resp = client.generate(...)
  File "/usr/local/lib/python3.11/site-packages/redwood/__init__.py", line 210, in generate
    return self._async_client.generate(*args, **kw)
RuntimeError: Event loop is closed
```
jen: Repro steps they gave:
```
python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install redwood-python==0.9.4 httpx==0.24.0 uvloop==0.17.0 fastapi==0.95.0
uvicorn app:app --loop uvloop --workers 1 --reload
# hit /enqueue many times to spin background tasks that call the sdk sync wrapper
```
sylvia: Interesting — two likely cooperating issues: 1) token refresh race causing bursts of 401 then rapid retries, 2) graceful shutdown/signal handling with uvloop + sync wrapper closing the loop under concurrent aclose/refresh.
alex: Any env vars or custom signal handlers? that often trips uvloop when worker process gets SIGTERM.
jen: They have a small shutdown handler that calls client.close() in a sync thread; might race with background tasks doing refresh.
support-bot: Created support incident INC-12347 and attached initial logs.
omar: Short-term mitigations to try with customer: set REDWOOD_PY_TOKEN_REFRESH_MUTEX=1 (ensures single refresh), and change their shutdown to schedule client.aclose() via asyncio.create_task instead of blocking sync .close(). Also reduce automatic retries in the client to avoid billing spike.
sylvia: Also try upgrading httpx to 0.24.1 or newer and redwood-python to 0.10.x — we've got a fix in 0.10.2 that adds an async refresh mutex and safer close semantics when loop is shutting down. If they can't upgrade, disable uvloop as a workaround: `uvicorn app:app --loop asyncio` (less performant but more stable here).
jen: Customer applied the token mutex env var and disabled uvloop — error count dropped immediately. They still see a small tail of `Event loop is closed` during deploys.
alex: For a proper fix we should add a guard in the sync wrapper: check `loop.is_running()` before calling `asyncio.get_event_loop().run_until_complete(...)` and raise clearer error or offload to a dedicated worker thread. Filed ENG-ISSUE-7881.
deploy-bot: linked ENG-ISSUE-7881 to INC-12347 and scheduled a follow-up with eng-runtime.
sylvia: Can you capture a short snippet to reproduce locally? I want a tiny harness that spawns N background tasks that concurrently trigger a token refresh and then send SIGTERM to the process after 2s. If we can reproduce we can validate the close fix.
jen: Will do and post a gist. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
